headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.

headlines.title: Price of parenting: the household maths giving China’s consumers pause
headlines.summary:
Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.
She bought a 624 sq ft flat last year, so her mother-in-law could move in and help care for her son. But the purchase now feels less prudent after prices in the 20-year-old complex have already fallen by about 10 per cent.

headlines.title_en: UK 2/10-year Treasury yield fell about 5 basis points
headlines.summary_en: On Tuesday (July 28), the UK 10-year bond yield fell 4.8 basis points in late European trading to 4.949%, remaining in decline throughout the session, with a trading range of 4.976%-4.945%, and a brief flash crash after 23:00 Beijing time approaching the daily low set at 16:48. The 2-year UK bond yield fell 5.3 basis points to 4.328%. The 30-year UK bond yield fell 3.2 basis points, and the 50-year yield fell 3.1 basis points. The 2/10-year UK bond yield spread rose 0.384 basis points to +61.725 basis points.

headlines.title_en: China: Intergovernmental negotiations are the only legitimate platform to discuss UN Security Council reform
headlines.summary_en: Sun Lei, interim charge d'affaires of China's Permanent Mission to the UN, spoke on the 28th after the General Assembly adopted a decision to transition the Intergovernmental Negotiations on Security Council reform, stating that the IGN is the only legitimate platform for discussing Security Council reform. Sun said China welcomes the General Assembly's adoption by consensus of an oral decision to technically transition the current session's IGN on Security Council reform to the next session. The IGN is the only legitimate platform for discussing Security Council reform, which concerns the vital interests of all countries. China hopes all parties will maintain a strategic vision and long-term perspective, jointly uphold the IGN's main channel status, adhere to the principle of consensus among member states, continue in-depth communication and build consensus within the IGN, and ensure the reform process moves in the only correct direction of enhancing the representation and voice of developing countries, steadily and sustainably. Sun said China is willing to work with all parties to continue promoting Security Council reform towards...
